name: pencil-to-code
description: Convert a Pencil.dev design to React + Tailwind code via the pencil-handoff skill.
notes: Cursor's native slash-command format is the companion .md file (pencil-to-code.md). This JSON mirror is kept for the handoff spec in pencil-to-cursor-handoff-visualization.md and for tools that parse command metadata.

arguments.name: pen_path
arguments.description: Path to the .pen file. Defaults to the currently focused file if it ends in .pen.

arguments.name: node_id
arguments.description: Pencil node id to scope the handoff to a single frame/component.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Destination path for the generated component file. Ask the user if omitted.

arguments.name: library
arguments.description: Path to the consuming repo's component library.

steps.prompt: Load the pencil-handoff skill at .cursor/skills/pencil-handoff/SKILL.md and follow its Steps section exactly. Resolve every $token in the .pen variables map to a semantic token from .design-system/reference/design-tokens-spec.md before emitting code. Match nodes to components using .cursor/rules/pencil-component-matching.mdc. Generate the component using .cursor/prompts/pencil-implementation.md as the template. Emit the handoff summary in the format defined by the skill.
